A partner in protecting the financial sector

Cleafy LABS partners with CERTFin, a key member of the European Financial Info Sharing and Analysis Center (FinISAC), alongside organisations such as Europol, the Dutch Payments Association, The Nordic Financial CERT, and the Polish Bank Association (ZBP).

United by a shared mission, safeguarding the integrity of the financial sector across Europe and beyond.
